body:
**This post is the single authoritative registration of the skills seat (seat 1, `domain:skills#1`).** Body **r268** (🟢 seated), written 2026-10-22T11:22Z by `session_0165fj9zYfUrt6ckcUgYBD5a` (`os-bill`). It uses the four-section template. The job description is versioned at `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md` and ⛔ is not copied here. r267 (⏳ vacant, 2026-10-21T08:47Z, `session_01M82feuetLzrCiBz41BJb7L` / `huangyiirene`) is the previous shift's sign-off ledger; its one stay-behind tail was cleared by comment 6312038387. Every earlier revision is in the edit history, ⛔ not restated. Seat 2's post is #19287 (⏳ vacant) and was not touched.

## Current PM

🟢 **`os-bill`** · `session_0165fj9zYfUrt6ckcUgYBD5a` · seated 2026-10-22T11:22Z on the maintainer's word in the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (Bill, 2026-10-22: 「我能不能不指定车道，你自己在 issue 上拉最新的p1 p2 的任务，按照优先级，交给对应的车道经理派发」 and 「注意后面总的并发5」; the project's coordinator opened this seat thread for the three queued skills cards).
- **Posture (this project's rules, maintainer's word 2026-10-22):** every M-or-larger, p1 or `security` card is dispatched as its own project thread (`mode:thread`), opened by the project coordinator under one project-wide cap of 5 card threads, p1 first; S-grade mechanical cards run as in-seat subagents. Effort follows difficulty (S medium, M high, L/XL · p1 · security · contract review xhigh). Orders are written to `/mnt/project-files/pm-skills-seat/dispatch-<issue>.md` and the card thread posts the seat-written claim with its own session and branch. Each card thread's review of record, ACCEPT and landing stay with this seat. The posture binds this session only.
- Opening mark: fetched `origin/main` `2919ddb875` at seating; `check-harness-current.mjs` read STALE for one file (`references/platform-readings.md`) against the thread's branch checkout, noted here and picked up at the next natural boundary, ⛔ no batch interrupted.

  - `pm:blocked` 1: #25069 (`Blocked-by: #24997`). `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 2: #24907 (no `Maintainer-action:` line, half-state carried from r267), #24351. Decision box 0 · `pm:on-hold` 0 · bare `finding` 0 · `tracking` 2 (#22060, #17161).

- **Tiers at seating** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, commit `2919ddb`): #25115 and #25191 MANDATORY `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by path (`SKILL.md`; #25115 also `os-dev.md`); #25070 no path mandate (Tier H prose, one-line mechanical: `TIER_DEFAULT` build, review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` in-seat); #25199 no path mandate (pure code face, `TIER_DEFAULT`).
- **Four-axis block:** `SKILL.md` L241–L261, md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0` (unchanged from r267).
